business_summary: Cal-Maine Foods, Inc. (Nasdaq: CALM) is the largest US shell egg producer and also runs egg products and prepared foods operations; it discloses avian influenza in its own 10-K and is placed on egg-processing for that processing role (its production role sits on the chain's separate layer-egg-production link, which remains OPEN in this census). The link is scored EMERGING (impact 60, crowdedness 42, capture 45, as of 2026-09-10), just above the undiscovered boundary: 'findable, therefore not undiscovered' per the chain's own rationale. CALM's own reported numbers are the clearest realized illustration of the chain's mechanism in this whole batch: revenue and net income swing sharply with HPAI-driven egg-price cycles (revenue 3,146,217,000 in fiscal year ended 2023-06-03 versus a spike to 4,261,885,000 in fiscal year ended 2025-05-31, then a partial reversion to 2,911,632,000 in fiscal year ended 2026-05-30; net income fell from 1,220,048,000 to 316,682,000 across the same last two years), which is why the 3-year revenue CAGR reads negative (-2.55%) despite the underlying volatility being a real, structural HPAI-driven price effect rather than secular decline.

exposure_summary.narrative: CALM holds 1 ACTIVE placement on h5n1-panzootic (egg-processing, link position 9, EMERGING, money_corner false). No HPAI-specific or outbreak-specific dollar impact is separately disclosed; the effect shows up as the volatility in CALM's own consolidated shell-egg pricing and results, described above.

confidence_audit.basis: Counts cover the canonical metric fields only. VERIFIED is a figure read directly off SEC companyfacts as reported. INFERRED with official_source true is computed from SEC companyfacts. SPECULATIVE covers the two reverse_dcf fields, which rest on an assumed discount rate and terminal growth rather than a reported figure. NULL is a field looked for in companyfacts and found genuinely missing or resting on a non-representative (multi-year-stale or zero-common-period) input, named on the field itself.
